description: This file contains helper functions related to financial calculations, such as determining the number of days in a year based on different 'basis' conventions and checking if a given date is the last day of the month.

classes.name: Helpers
classes.description: A utility class providing helper functions for financial calculations related to date and day count conventions.

methods.name: daysPerYear
methods.description: Calculates the number of days in a specified year based on a given 'basis' parameter, which defines different day count conventions.

methods.name: isLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Determines whether a given date is the last day of its month.
